title: CISO Conversations: Patti Degnan – Part of the Job Is Deciding What Not to Do
description: This content is an interview-style article featuring Patti Degnan, a cybersecurity leader whose career was influenced by her personal experience with identity theft. The article discusses her journey to becoming a CISO, leadership perspectives, and evolving cybersecurity challenges, particularly the shift from individual identity theft to broader enterprise credential threats. It highlights the growing role of CISOs as business enablers and the importance of leadership and team dynamics in cybersecurity.
